about: The default lab's physical inventory (chemlab/inventory.py): one record per container at a storage place and position, with contents, storage class and source. Matterix can spawn the same containers; chemlab shows them (chemlab list --inventory [ID]). Moving a container is a host or robot action. Variant quantos_powder: robot powder dosing task (BRIEF_QUANTOS): Quantos empty at the start; heads in their containers on the bench shelf T2-03 (CaCO3) / T2-04 (KBr); empty 20 mL vials in the bench vial rack A01..A04 (row B stays empty)

places.type: stepped two-tier shelf on the robot bench (T1 front/low, T2 rear/high), all positions within the fixed arm's reach: the containers the robot handles (common solvents, pH buffers, the smoke workflows' standards)
open room reagent rack, 4 shelves x 8 positions (out of the fixed arm's reach)
closed cabinet for check standards and certified reference materials, 3 shelves x 8
90 cm safety cabinet for flammable liquids (EN 14470-1 type 90), 3 shelves x 6
ventilated corrosives cabinet, acid compartment, 2 shelves x 6
ventilated corrosives cabinet, base compartment, 2 shelves x 6
ventilated, lockable cabinet for toxic substances, 2 shelves x 6

benchtop desiccator cabinet with a hinged door on the robot bench, silica gel, 2 shelves x 6; side access only for the fixed arm (161 mm headroom, the door sweep blocks the route: measured in the Isaac Sim storage scene), so not for top-down robot picks

MACHEREY-NAGEL 702503 rack for 20 mL headspace vials (3 rows x 12) on the robot bench next to the bench shelf, >= 0.25 m free above the vial tops; the robot uses rows A and C only (fingers close along Y: a vial in row B would overlap them by 11 mm), so row B stays empty
cabinet for labware consumables, 4 shelves x 8
wall rack for gas cylinders with chains, 8 slots (inert and oxidizing gases)
ventilated gas cabinet for flammable gases, 4 slots
inside an instrument (position named per instrument)

container_types_source: assets/labware/catalog.json types (inventory_type_map); ids still provisional where the catalog has not built the item (type_status not_built)
conventions: containers: one record per container in storage (Matterix spawns these). contents: shared substance ids (assets/reactions/substances.json) with a physical amount (g, kg, mg, mL, L, uL, mol, mmol); a solution lists its solvent (a liquid, by volume or mass) and every solute with its mass (or amount in mol) and its concentration; a mixture substance (kind mixture in the table) describes itself. count = number of units in the container; per_unit = true: the contents amounts are those of one unit; units = [{name, count, contents}] for a pack of different units (e.g. a kit or a standards set). instrument_contents: what the default set-up put into each instrument (the instruments' own state, not spawned): a runtime material is named with defined_by (its composition is the instrument runtime's sample / template). cap: "on" | "off" - the closure of a container whose type has one (catalog closure: screw cap, hinged or lift-off lid); absent = "on" (closed); "off" = opened, the cap set aside (e.g. vials prepared open for a dosing run).

containers.source: head: METTLER TOLEDO QH016-BNMW (part 11141503), 16 mL, 0.1-250 mg per dose (manual: quantos_operating_instructions p.102, p.107); fill: 75 % of the 16 mL volume (12 mL, headspace left for the dosing mechanism: assumption) x KBr bulk density 950 kg/m3 (Merck 104907 product page: 900-1000 kg/m3) = 11.4 g. Stands in its storage container (manual p.27). KBr is hygroscopic: in its closed head on the bench for a working day is acceptable (it takes up water only slowly below about 60 % RH and deliquesces near 80 %); between working days the head belongs in the desiccator. A host or the robot inserts it; the Quantos registers it as head qh_kbr_1 with 0.0114 kg of free-flowing powder
